Shokk Jumpa: While this model is leading a unit, that unit gains the Phase Shift ability. Additionally, when the unit Moves, roll a D6. On a 4+, the unit increases its Movement characteristic to 12".

Fixin' It: Once per Battle Round, during your Command Phase, you can use this ability. To do so, select 1 friendly Ork Vehicle within 3" of this model and roll a D6. On a 1, the Vehicle suffers D3+1 Mortal Wounds. On a 2-4, the Vehicle regains up to D3+1 lost Wounds. On a 5-6, the model regains up to D6+1 lost wounds, and, until the end of the Battle Round, increases its Movement characteristic by 3" and gains the Relentless ability, but all of its weapons gain the Hazardous D3+1 ability.

sections.prose:
Da Jump [Psychic]: While this model is leading a unit, it can attempt use this ability. If the Psychic Test is passed, the unit can immediately be removed from the battlefield and placed anywhere else on the battlefield as if it was using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action. However, on a roll of a 1, immediately remove the unit from the battlefield and roll another D6. If the result is a 1 or a 6, the unit is destroyed. On any other roll, the unit is placed into Strategic Reserves.

I See 'Em! [Psychic]: Once per Battle Round, during your Command Phase, it can attempt to use this ability. To do so, select an enemy unit within 18" of this model and complete a Psychic Test. If successful, that selected unit cannot benefit from Light Cover or Heavy Cover for the duration of the Battle Round.
